name: @knf/wayfindengine
description: Headless indoor wayfinding for React Native / Expo — a building graph with levels, rooms, nodes and typed edges, A* routing with accessibility modes, turn-by-turn instruction generation with landmarks and connector collapsing, a navigation state machine, QR anchors and room search. Bring your own floor plans; pair with @knf/wayfinduikit or any UI.
